lead.en: Show a value against a known range with a named status.
lead.zh: 以圆弧显示数值在范围中的位置，并可标明状态。

rule.en: The host owns the value. The display clamps to the range; non-finite updates are ignored.
rule.zh: 宿主持有数值；显示限制在范围内，非有限数值更新会被忽略。

api.en: Use with_range, with_detail, with_tone and with_thresholds to configure the meter.
api.zh: 使用 with_range、with_detail、with_tone 和 with_thresholds 配置仪表。

motion.en: The arc and displayed count follow one spring; reduced motion reaches the target immediately.
motion.zh: 弧线和数字随同一弹簧变化；减少动效时直接显示目标值。

lead.en: Give a changing total a directional, place-keyed digit roll.
lead.zh: 按数位和数值变化方向滚动数字。

rule.en: The host supplies values. Non-finite updates are ignored; formatting uses comma grouping and up to six decimal places.
rule.zh: 由宿主提供数值；忽略非有限值，使用逗号分组，最多保留六位小数。

api.en: Use with_label, with_prefix, with_suffix, with_decimals and with_size. Opt into a first reveal with with_animate_on_view(true); it starts at 60% visibility. Hosts call set_visible when hiding the control.
api.zh: 使用 with_label、with_prefix、with_suffix、with_decimals 和 with_size 配置格式；with_animate_on_view(true) 在首次可见面积达到 60% 后从零滚动。宿主隐藏控件时调用 set_visible。

motion.en: Digits retain their place and spring toward the updated value; reduced motion updates immediately.
motion.zh: 每个数位保留位置并向新值弹动；减少动效时直接更新。

lead.en: Compare category shares in a 100-cell grid.
lead.zh: 以 100 个单元格比较各分类占比。

rule.en: Legend toggles filter categories; at least one remains visible. Arrow keys inspect grid cells.
rule.zh: 图例可切换分类，至少保留一项；使用方向键查看单元格。

api.en: Supply stable category ids, labels, values and colors; subscribe to WaffleInspect for the active category.
api.zh: 提供稳定分类 ID、名称、数值和颜色；订阅 WaffleInspect 获取当前分类。

motion.en: Cells retain identity and spring to their new positions; reduced motion places them immediately.
motion.zh: 单元格保留身份并弹动至新位置；减少动效时立即到位。

lead.en: Compare paired measurements across two points.
lead.zh: 比较多个数据系列的前后变化。

rule.en: Hover a line, select its legend item or use arrow keys to inspect a series.
rule.zh: 悬停线条、选择图例或使用方向键查看数据。

api.en: Provide stable series IDs, labels and paired values. Use with_highlight to choose the initial highlight and subscribe to SlopeInspect.
api.zh: 提供稳定系列 ID、名称和前后数值。使用 with_highlight 设定初始高亮，订阅 SlopeInspect 读取焦点系列。

motion.en: Existing series interpolate from their current positions when new values arrive.
motion.zh: 数据更新时已有系列从当前位置弹动到新的位置。

lead.en: Compare multiple profiles across shared dimensions.
lead.zh: 在多个共同维度上比较数据系列。

rule.en: Use three to twelve axes. Missing and non-finite values render as zero; values are clamped to 0–100.
rule.zh: 支持三至十二个维度；缺失或非有限值按零显示，数值限制在 0–100。

api.en: Set axes and profiles at construction; replace profiles with set_profiles. Arrows or axis buttons inspect values.
api.zh: 创建时设置维度与数据系列；使用 set_profiles 更新。方向键和维度按钮可查看数值。

motion.en: Matching profile IDs retain their current vertex positions as values change; reduced motion updates immediately.
motion.zh: 同一系列 ID 的顶点从当前位置移动到新值；减少动效时直接更新。

lead.en: Compare shares in one bar; inspect a segment to give its label space.
lead.zh: 以单条图比较占比，查看某部分时为它的标签留出空间。

rule.en: Use stable unique IDs. Non-finite and negative values are treated as zero.
rule.zh: 使用稳定且唯一的 ID；无效或负数值按零处理。

api.en: Provide stable ids, labels, values and colors; with_description and with_unit configure the header. Call set_segments to update data and set_visible when the host hides the chart.
api.zh: 提供稳定 ID、名称、数值和颜色；with_description 和 with_unit 配置标题。set_segments 更新数据，宿主隐藏图表时调用 set_visible。

motion.en: Inspection expands a segment while the others give way proportionally. Edges and fitted labels retarget their current spring trajectories; hidden charts stop requesting animation frames.
motion.zh: 查看某部分时它会展开，其余部分按比例让位；边缘及内外标签从当前弹簧轨迹接续，隐藏时停止请求动画帧。

lead.en: Inspect and compare changing data.
lead.zh: 查看和比较变化的数据。

rule.en: Use stable unique IDs. Non-finite and negative values are treated as zero.
rule.zh: 使用稳定且唯一的 ID；无效或负数值按零处理。

api.en: Provide stable RaceEntry IDs and ordered RaceFrame values; missing IDs count as zero. set_frame seeks, set_playing controls playback, set_visible stops offscreen updates. RaceFrameChanged and RacePlaybackChanged report interaction.
api.zh: 使用稳定的 RaceEntry 标识及有序 RaceFrame 数据，缺失标识按零处理；set_frame 切换时间段，set_playing 控制播放，set_visible 控制离屏更新。RaceFrameChanged 和 RacePlaybackChanged 报告交互。

motion.en: A host-supplied timeline interpolates values between periods; the default duration is 1400 ms per period. Playback pauses offscreen, and reduced motion disables autoplay and steps between periods. Real browser, touch, accessibility and frame-by-frame comparison are still pending.
motion.zh: 时间轴在宿主提供的时间段间插值，默认每段 1400 毫秒；离屏暂停，减少动效时不自动播放并按时间段切换。真实浏览器、触屏、无障碍和逐帧对照仍待验收。

lead.en: Inspect conversion across ordered stages and compare two segments.
lead.zh: 查看各阶段的转化率并对比两个细分组。

rule.en: Stages use stable IDs. Values follow segment order; invalid and negative values count as zero.
rule.zh: 阶段使用稳定 ID，数值按细分组排列；无效值和负值按零处理。

api.en: Select a segment or compare two segments; inspect stages with pointer, touch or arrow keys. Call set_visible(false, cx) when the embedding host hides the chart; particle phase resumes without a catch-up jump. with_flow and set_flow control the optional particles.
api.zh: 可选择细分组或对比两组；用指针、触摸或方向键查看阶段。 宿主隐藏图表时调用 set_visible(false, cx)，粒子恢复时从原来的相位继续。 with_flow 和 set_flow 控制可选的粒子流。

motion.en: Bands morph from their current shape. Flow stops outside the viewport or under reduced motion.
motion.zh: 带状图从当前形状过渡；离开视口和减少动效时粒子停止。

lead.en: Compare layered time series and inspect individual points.
lead.zh: 比较多个时间序列并查看数据点。

rule.en: Each point contains values in layer order. Invalid or negative values count as zero.
rule.zh: 数据点数值按图层顺序排列；无效值和负值按零处理。

api.en: Update points with set_points; toggle legend entries and use arrow keys or pointer to inspect.
api.zh: 使用 set_points 更新数据；点击图例筛选，用方向键或指针查看。

motion.en: Data ranges interpolate on a shared grid; reduced motion jumps to the target.
motion.zh: 数据区间在共享网格上平滑过渡；减少动效时立即显示目标值。

lead.en: Explore hierarchical values with a responsive squarified layout.
lead.zh: 在自适应的矩形排布中浏览层级数据。

rule.en: IDs must be unique within each level. An empty parent value uses the sum of its children.
rule.zh: 同一层级的 ID 必须唯一；父节点数值为零时使用子节点之和。

api.en: Use with_metrics for sizes and with_shades for explicit colors. For numeric shading, use with_shade_values and with_color_scales; with_branch_hues preserves each branch's hue.
api.zh: 使用 with_metrics 配置面积指标，或用 with_shades 指定颜色；数值着色使用 with_shade_values 与 with_color_scales，with_branch_hues 可保留各分支色相。

motion.en: Tiles zoom during drill-down, and matching IDs reflow when the metric changes; reduced motion updates directly.
motion.zh: 钻取时区域缩放，指标改变时相同 ID 平滑重排；减少动效时直接更新。

lead.en: Inspect a time series and drag an overview window to zoom.
lead.zh: 查看时间序列，通过概览区间缩放。

rule.en: Points are ordered by time. Window endpoints are inclusive indices.
rule.zh: 数据按时间排序，区间两端为包含端点的索引。

api.en: Drag the window or handles; keyboard users can pan and resize. Optional presets select the most recent points.
api.zh: 可拖动窗口或手柄，也可用键盘平移和缩放；预设可选择最近的数据。

motion.en: The line reveals on entry; controlled window changes and axis range use springs. Reduced motion updates directly.
motion.zh: 折线进入视口时绘制；区间和数值轴平滑过渡。减少动效时直接更新。

lead.en: Compare distributions and inspect their quartiles.
lead.zh: 比较多组分布，并查看四分位。

rule.en: Non-finite samples are ignored; IDs stay stable between datasets.
rule.zh: 忽略非有限样本；数据切换时保持 ID 稳定。

api.en: Use pointer, touch or arrow keys to inspect a ridge and its quartiles.
api.zh: 可用指针、触摸或方向键查看曲线及四分位。

motion.en: Curves interpolate on a shared grid and the selected ridge lifts. Reduced motion updates directly.
motion.zh: 曲线在共享网格上过渡，选中曲线轻微上升；减少动效时直接更新。

lead.en: Monitor a live series and pause it to inspect individual readings.
lead.zh: 查看实时序列，暂停后检查具体数据。

rule.en: Focus the plot to hold the latest visible reading. Use the arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End to inspect. Space or Enter toggles pause, and Escape clears inspection. On narrow cards the pause button moves beside the title. The host owns the feed and tracks visibility.
rule.zh: 键盘焦点进入图表时暂停在最新可见读数。用方向键、Page Up、Page Down、Home 和 End 查看。空格或 Enter 切换暂停，Escape 清除读数。窄卡片上的暂停按钮位于标题旁。数据源和可见性由宿主管理。

api.en: Use set_visible and set_paused to control rendering; an optional anomaly label identifies unusual readings.
api.zh: 使用 set_visible 与 set_paused 控制显示；异常数据可附加标签。

motion.en: New observations slide in as the axis resizes. The unit follows the rolling digits as their width changes. Hover freezes the chart, and reduced motion updates directly.
motion.zh: 新数据滑入时数值轴平滑调整，单位随数字宽度平滑移动。悬停暂停画面，减少动效时直接更新。

lead.en: Explore hierarchical values as nested rings.
lead.zh: 通过多层圆环探索层级数据。

rule.en: Node IDs must be unique. Branch values are sums of children; non-finite and negative leaf values contribute zero.
rule.zh: 节点 ID 必须唯一；父节点数值由子节点求和，非有限值和负叶节点值按零计算。

api.en: Use arrow keys to select, Enter to focus, and Escape to return. Labels are shaped as whole horizontal words and hidden when the segment is too small.
api.zh: 方向键选择、回车进入、Esc 返回。标签整词水平排版；扇区空间不足时隐藏标签。

motion.en: Arc geometry and center digits transition between levels; reduced motion updates directly.
motion.zh: 层级切换时扇区和中心数字过渡；减少动效时直接更新。

lead.en: Follow quantities through stages that split and merge.
lead.zh: 查看数据在各阶段的分流与汇合。

rule.en: Use unique node IDs and forward links. Non-finite, non-positive, missing-node and reverse links are ignored. Set visibility from the host to stop particle frames off screen.
rule.zh: 节点 ID 须唯一，连接须向后续列前进；非有限值、非正值、缺失节点及逆向连接会被忽略。宿主应同步可见性以停止屏外粒子帧。

api.en: Tab inspects the first node. Arrow keys navigate the plot and Escape clears the trace. Use with_height, with_value_formatter and with_empty_label to customize the plot. The host can accept FlowParticlesChange requests with set_particles.
api.zh: Tab 进入首个节点，方向键在图中导航，Esc 清除追踪。可用 with_height、with_value_formatter 和 with_empty_label 设置图高、数值格式和空状态。宿主可用 set_particles 响应 FlowParticlesChange 请求。

motion.en: Ribbons and nodes morph between datasets. Inspecting a flow fills the traced share on a 0.26s spring, and clearing the highlight drains it. Reduced motion applies the trace immediately and removes particles.
motion.zh: 切换数据时流带和节点连续变形。查看流向时，按追踪比例在 0.26 秒弹簧中填充流带，清除后回退。减少动效时立即显示追踪结果并关闭粒子。

lead.en: Scan changing metrics and inspect their recent history.
lead.zh: 浏览实时指标并查看近期变化。

rule.en: Use unique stable IDs. The host owns updates and visibility; non-finite values are ignored, and a zero baseline has no percentage change.
rule.zh: 使用稳定且唯一的 ID；数据更新与可见性由宿主管理。非有限值会被忽略，基线为零时不计算百分比变化。

api.en: Configure format, delta type, favorable direction and history per metric. Hover, focus or tap to inspect; use set_visible when outside the viewport. Touch and screen-reader behavior still require device testing.
api.zh: 每项可设置格式、变化方式、有利方向和历史数据。悬停、聚焦或点击可查看趋势；离开视口时应通过 set_visible 同步状态。触屏及读屏仍待实机验证。

motion.en: Digits roll and the overflow strip drifts while visible; reduced motion disables automatic drift. Frame-by-frame visual comparison remains pending.
motion.zh: 数字逐位滚动，溢出时可见区域自动循环；减少动效时关闭自动滚动。逐帧视觉对照仍待完成。

lead.en: Compare daily goals on concentric progress rings.
lead.zh: 通过同心圆环比较每日目标进度。

rule.en: Supply stable goal and day IDs. A non-positive goal reports zero progress; values above 100% draw a second lap up to 200%.
rule.zh: 目标和日期应使用稳定 ID；无效或非正目标按零进度显示，超过 100% 的部分以第二圈显示，绘制上限为 200%。

api.en: Use arrow keys to move focus and selection through the week. set_days preserves the selected day by ID and emits ActivityGoalClosed when a value on that day crosses its goal.
api.zh: 方向键在一周内同时移动日期选择和键盘焦点。set_days 按 ID 保留所选日期，同一天的数值从低于目标升至达标时发出 ActivityGoalClosed。

motion.en: Rings and values retarget from their current state; reduced motion updates directly. Visual frame comparison is pending.
motion.zh: 圆环与数字从当前位置过渡到新值；减少动效时直接更新。视觉逐帧对照尚未完成。

lead.en: Explain the stages of an illustrative model training run.
lead.zh: 以示意动画解释模型训练的各个阶段。

rule.en: Values are illustrative and must not be presented as actual training metrics. The host should synchronize visibility to stop animation off screen.
rule.zh: 数值仅为示意，不应当作真实训练指标。宿主应同步可见性，以停止屏外动画。

api.en: Configure data counts, classes, epochs, loss and target through TrainingConfig. Use stage buttons or set_step to inspect and set_paused for playback.
api.zh: 使用 TrainingConfig 设置样本数、类别、轮次、损失及目标；通过阶段按钮或 set_step 查看，用 set_paused 控制播放。

motion.en: A 21-second sequence shows signal travel, learning, loss and evaluation; reduced motion shows a still frame. The stacks and fine-grained motion differ from the reference and visual, touch and screen-reader validation remain pending.
motion.zh: 21 秒示意过程展示信号、训练、损失和评估；减少动效时显示静态画面。数据堆栈与细节动效仍有差异，视觉、触屏和读屏验收尚未完成。

lead.en: Visualize host-provided regional health and traffic shifts.
lead.zh: 展示宿主提供的区域健康状态与流量切换。

rule.en: The host owns health and requests. Only resolve a matching request ID; failure preserves the prior snapshot, and stale responses are ignored.
rule.zh: 健康状态和切换请求由宿主管理。仅匹配请求 ID 的结果会生效；失败时保留原状态，过期响应被忽略。

api.en: Stage buttons request a phase; call resolve after the asynchronous operation, and set_visible to stop off-screen motion. The demo intentionally fails the first failover request to exercise retry.
api.zh: 阶段按钮发出切换请求；异步操作完成后调用 resolve，离开视口时调用 set_visible。示例首次切换会模拟失败，供验证重试。

motion.en: Confirmed weights interpolate, particles pause when hidden or reduced motion is enabled. The reference's detailed 2.5D scene is not yet reproduced, and visual, touch and screen-reader validation remain pending.
motion.zh: 确认后的流量比例平滑过渡；隐藏或减少动效时暂停粒子。参考站的 2.5D 细节尚未完整实现，视觉、触屏和读屏仍待验收。

lead.en: Illustrate how host-provided sources feed a processing step and destinations.
lead.zh: 以示意图展示宿主提供的来源、处理环节和目标。

rule.en: The host supplies the processed count and service state; the illustration never generates real records. Use stable node IDs and destination shares between zero and one.
rule.zh: 处理数与服务状态由宿主提供，插图本身不会生成真实记录；节点 ID 应稳定，目标分流比例限制在 0 到 1。

api.en: Use arrows, Home and End to inspect nodes; set_visible stops off-screen animation and set_paused controls illustration playback. The demo uses explicitly labelled sample data.
api.zh: 使用方向键、Home 和 End 查看节点；set_visible 用于停止屏外动画，set_paused 控制示意动画。示例明确标注为模拟数据。

motion.en: Hollow source markers become solid destination markers, with reduced motion showing a still frame. Detailed path motion, accessibility and device behavior still require verification.
motion.zh: 空心来源标记经过处理后变为实心目标标记；减少动效时显示静态画面。路径动效、无障碍及设备体验仍待验收。

lead.en: Follow a simulated card payment through authorization, settlement and payout.
lead.zh: 查看一笔模拟刷卡付款如何完成授权、结算和入账。

rule.en: Amounts are in major currency units. The figure simulates a card payment without contacting a payment service.
rule.zh: 金额以主货币单位传入。示意图模拟刷卡流程，无需连接支付服务。

api.en: Set the amount, fee, balance, currency, locale, authorization duration, node overrides, labels, accent and playback in PaymentFlowOptions. Use with_mark for custom GPUI art and with_money_formatter for other locale formats.
api.zh: 通过 PaymentFlowOptions 配置金额、手续费、余额、货币、区域、授权耗时、节点、文案、强调色和播放。用 with_mark 提供自定义 GPUI 图形，with_money_formatter 接入其他区域格式。

motion.en: The chip returns with approval, then the settlement rail deducts the fee. The balance accumulates payouts. Under 700px the diagram is vertical. Reduced motion shows the net payout in transit.
motion.zh: 授权结果沿原路返回。结算轨道扣除手续费，余额逐轮累加。宽度小于 700px 时图形竖排，减少动效时停在净额入账前。

lead.en: Follow a simulated DNS lookup through referrals, connection and a cached response.
lead.zh: 跟随一次模拟 DNS 查询，查看服务器转介、建立连接和缓存应答。

rule.en: The domain and answer are sample records. The figure makes no network requests.
rule.zh: 域名和地址是示例记录，示意图不会发送网络请求。

api.en: Configure the domain, address, TTL, lookup time, cached time, node details, accent, speed and visible controls with DnsResolutionOptions.
api.zh: 通过 DnsResolutionOptions 配置域名、地址、TTL、查询和缓存耗时、节点详情、强调色、播放速度与可见控件。

motion.en: Seek with the six step buttons, Left, Right, Home or End. Reduced motion shows still phases.
motion.zh: 六个步骤可直接跳转，也可用左右方向键、Home 或 End。减少动效时只显示静态阶段。

lead.en: Explain a host-supplied vector search result with an illustrative projection.
lead.zh: 使用示意投影解释宿主提供的向量检索结果。

rule.en: The host supplies documents, projection coordinates, links, result order and scores. Coordinates are illustrative and do not calculate real similarity.
rule.zh: 文档、投影坐标、索引连接、结果顺序与分数均由宿主提供；坐标仅作示意，不用于计算真实相似度。

api.en: Use stage buttons or set_stage to inspect, set_paused for playback, and set_visible to stop off-screen animation.
api.zh: 使用阶段按钮或 set_stage 查看流程，用 set_paused 控制播放，set_visible 用于停止屏外动画。

motion.en: The illustration progresses through embedding, indexing, query and results; reduced motion shows a still frame. The reference's 2.5D geometry and detailed transitions are not yet reproduced, and device/accessibility validation remains pending.
motion.zh: 示意过程依次展示嵌入、索引、查询与结果；减少动效时显示静态画面。参考站的 2.5D 几何和细节动效尚未完整实现，设备及无障碍验收仍待完成。

lead.en: Inspect Git history and preview merge, rebase, and squash strategies.
lead.zh: 查看 Git 提交历史，并预览合并、变基和压缩策略。

rule.en: Use the arrows and Home or End in the strategy picker or commit list. Escape closes details.
rule.zh: 在策略选择器或提交列表中使用方向键、Home 或 End。按 Esc 关闭详情。

api.en: Provide commits newest first, lane order, and a pull request. Controlled hosts subscribe to BranchStrategyChange and apply set_strategy.
api.zh: 传入按时间倒序排列的提交、轨道顺序和合并请求。受控模式订阅 BranchStrategyChange，并调用 set_strategy 回写。

motion.en: Connectors follow commits as histories change. Reduced motion switches instantly and stops autoplay.
motion.zh: 历史切换时，连线随提交移动。减少动效时直接切换并停止自动播放。
